note: Anti-CD20 antibodies (ocrelizumab, ofatumumab, ublituximab, divozilimab) entered MS on rituximab's clinical signal; monkeys were the only pharmacologically relevant species and EAE the disease model.
label: Multiple sclerosis (anti-CD20 depleters)

engagement.confidence_note: FDA review text (OCR) of the CLL BLA; the quote keeps the OCR rendering of CD20+.
engagement.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
engagement.note: Ofatumumab (approved for CLL) depleted circulating B cells in monkeys from 1.25 mg/kg; no MS patient data yet.
engagement.quote: In healthy cynomolgus monkeys treated with ofatumumab, doses as low as 1.25 mg/kg were sufficient to deplete circulating CD20" B-cells to ~4 to 10% of baseline at the earliest time point measured
engagement.judgement: Opened at the first public monkey depletion data for a member; ocrelizumab's own 2002-2003 monkey PK/PD studies were unpublished until its 2017 BLA review.

engagement.magnitude_basis: peripheral B-cell depletion (monkey >99% at 10 mg/kg vs near-complete CD19+ depletion in patients)
engagement.confidence_note: Both halves from the 2017 BLA package (pharmacology review and label); model and patient data sit in different documents.
engagement.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
engagement.note: Monkeys lost >99% of blood B cells after 10 mg/kg ocrelizumab; MS patients' CD19+ B cells fell by 14 days after infusion. Retrodiction ruling: the ocrelizumab monkey data were first public in the 2017 review, after anti-CD20 B-cell depletion was known in patients (rituximab; ocrelizumab phase 2, 2011).
engagement.quote: Treatment with OCREVUS reduces CD19+ B-cell counts in blood by 14 days after infusion.
engagement.judgement: Paired, not stated. B-cell count read as proximal (elimination of the CD20-bearing cell), not direct occupancy. Ublituximab (2022 label: CD19+ depletion within 24 h) agrees.

dose.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
dose.note: Monkey doses mapped only to the CLL label dose; no MS regimen or exposure target was derived from them.
dose.short: No MS dose target from monkeys
dose.quote: the doses administered to healthy monkeys may not be directly relevant to patients with CLL.
dose.judgement: MS regimens (ocrelizumab 600 mg q24w, ofatumumab 20 mg sc, ublituximab 450 mg) came from rituximab experience and phase 2 dose-ranging, not from monkey PK/PD.

dose.magnitude_basis: tolerability margin: NOAEL 100 mg/kg vs 600 mg (~8.6 mg/kg at 70 kg) given without dose-limiting toxicity
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level for OPERA; NOAEL quoted from the FDA pharmacology review ('Ocrelizumab was well tolerated at both dose levels... The NOAEL is the HD of 100 mg/kg').
dose.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
dose.note: Ocrelizumab NOAEL 100 mg/kg in monkeys, about 12-fold the 600 mg clinical dose; patients were dosed to it without non-pharmacological toxicity. Retrodiction ruling: the monkey NOAEL was first public in the 2017 review, after ocrelizumab's own patients were dosed at 600 mg (phase 2 2011; OPERA online Dec 2016).
dose.quote: Serious infection occurred in 1.3% of the patients treated with ocrelizumab and in 2.9% of those treated with interferon beta-1a.
dose.judgement: Scored only the margin half (decision 16); the regimen half has no monkey-stated target. Year set to the review's public date (2017), not OPERA's Dec 2016 epub. Ublituximab's monkey program set no NOAEL, so it adds nothing.

dose.note: Model fit to pooled ofatumumab RMS data to simulate B-cell depletion across monthly SC doses.
dose.quote: The population PK-B cell model was used to simulate B cell depletion and repletion times and the effect of covariates on PK and B cell metrics, as well as the dose response across a range of subcutaneous ofatumumab monthly doses.
dose.judgement: Opens the track at publication; the model was built after ASCLEPIOS had already run on 20 mg.
dose.model: Population PK-B cell model of subcutaneous ofatumumab in RMS (pooled phase 2/3, 1486 patients)

dose.magnitude_basis: B-cell target (MIRROR-derived, below 10 cells/uL) vs simulated median 8 cells/uL at day 11 on 20 mg
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level; the model was fit to the same phase 2/3 patients it describes, so it confirms rather than predicts.
dose.note: Simulations reproduced the B-cell target reached by the licensed 20 mg regimen, with negligible repletion between doses.
dose.quote: The predetermined B cell target was best achieved and sustained with the 20-mg dose regimen, with median B cell count reaching 8 cells/µL in 11 days and negligible repletion between doses.
dose.judgement: Retrodiction: built after the 20 mg dose was chosen and tested; the authors frame it as confirming the dose.
dose.model: Population PK-B cell model of subcutaneous ofatumumab in RMS (pooled phase 2/3, 1486 patients)

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC). Anti-CD20 is a mouse antibody, not a member.
efficacy.model: Mouse EAE induced by recombinant MOG, mouse anti-CD20
efficacy.note: B-cell depletion prevented or reversed B-cell-dependent rMOG EAE but worsened peptide EAE; members not yet in MS trials with results.
efficacy.quote: B-cell depletion prevented or reversed established rMOG-induced EAE, which was associated with less central nervous system (CNS) inflammation, elimination of meningeal B cells, and reduction of MOG-specific Th1 and Th17 cells.
efficacy.judgement: The rMOG paradigm taken as the model; the same paper's MOG35-55 arm, where depletion exacerbated EAE, was framed by the authors as a B-cell-independent paradigm, not a class prediction.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: EAE clinical score vs MRI lesion count; no common scale
efficacy.model: Mouse EAE induced by recombinant MOG, mouse anti-CD20
efficacy.note: Ocrelizumab phase 2 met its primary endpoint: gadolinium-enhancing lesions 89% lower than placebo at 600 mg. Retrodiction ruling: the model result (Weber 2010) was first public after rituximab's phase 2 HERMES trial (NEJM, Feb 2008) showed anti-CD20 depletion cut MS lesions.
efficacy.quote: at week 24, the number of gadolinium-enhancing lesions was 89% (95% CI 68-97; p<0·0001) lower in the 600 mg ocrelizumab group than in the placebo group
efficacy.reason: Every member met its primary endpoint
efficacy.judgement: Paired, not stated: Kappos 2011 does not cite the EAE data side by side. The class's entry to MS rested on rituximab's HERMES trial more than on EAE.

patient_trials.quote: The annualized relapse rate was lower with ocrelizumab than with interferon beta-1a in trial 1 (0.16 vs. 0.29; 46% lower rate with ocrelizumab; P<0.001)
Efficacy and Safety of Ofatumumab Compared to Teriflunomide in Patients With Relapsing Multiple Sclerosis (registry title; results posted)
In the ULTIMATE I trial, the annualized relapse rate was 0.08 with ublituximab and 0.19 with teriflunomide (rate ratio, 0.41; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.27 to 0.62; P<0.001)
The use of DIV was associated with a statistically significant decrease in ARR compared to TRF (p=0.0001).

efficacy.magnitude_basis: lesion cell counts vs relapse rate
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC). Its hint that ofatumumab beats ocrelizumab has no head-to-head trial.
efficacy.model: Humanized-CD20 mouse with brain DTH lesions and tertiary lymphoid structures
efficacy.note: After both were approved, ofatumumab and ocrelizumab cut B and T cells and glial activation in brain lesions of huCD20 mice. Scored here on the ofatumumab subcutaneous arm; the ocrelizumab intravenous arm is its own track.
efficacy.short: Approved members reproduce in huCD20 mice
efficacy.quote: Both treatments significantly decreased the extent of glial activation, as well as the number of B- and T-cells in the lesion following SC and IV administration
efficacy.judgement: Scored retro: built after OPERA and ASCLEPIOS were known. The patient side is the members' phase 3 primary endpoints.

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 20739677). HuMab 7D8 is a sibling human anti-CD20 (Genmab), not a member; epub 2010-08-25.
efficacy.note: Late HuMab 7D8 B-cell depletion halted clinical EAE and limited MRI lesions in rhMOG-immunised marmosets; no member had MS trial results.
efficacy.quote: Whereas all of the control monkeys developed clinically evident EAE, overt neurologic deficits were reduced substantially in three HuMab 7D8-treated monkeys, and four HuMab 7D8-treated monkeys remained completely asymptomatic.
efficacy.judgement: Treatment started 21 days after immunisation, so it predicts therapeutic depletion in ongoing disease; the 2014 follow-up (Kap 2014, doi 10.4049/jimmunol.1303125) is mechanism only and adds no new comparison.
efficacy.model: Marmoset EAE (rhMOG/CFA) with late B-cell depletion by HuMab 7D8, a human anti-CD20

efficacy.magnitude_basis: marmoset clinical EAE score and MRI lesion size vs human gadolinium-enhancing lesion count
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level for both papers; paired by us.
efficacy.quote: at week 24, the number of gadolinium-enhancing lesions was 89% (95% CI 68-97; p<0·0001) lower in the 600 mg ocrelizumab group than in the placebo group
efficacy.note: Marmoset MRI lesions shrank with anti-CD20; ocrelizumab phase 2 cut gadolinium-enhancing lesions 89% versus placebo. Retrodiction ruling: the model result (Kap 2010) was first public after rituximab's phase 2 HERMES trial (NEJM, Feb 2008) showed anti-CD20 depletion cut MS lesions.
efficacy.judgement: Paired, not stated: Kappos 2011 does not cite the marmoset study. MRI lesion reduction in marmosets is the closest model readout to the phase 2 primary endpoint.
efficacy.model: Marmoset EAE (rhMOG/CFA) with late B-cell depletion by HuMab 7D8, a human anti-CD20

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 18802481). Mouse anti-CD20 (MB20-11), not a member.
efficacy.note: Anti-CD20 before induction worsened peptide EAE by removing IL-10 B10 cells; depletion during progression suppressed symptoms.
efficacy.quote: Rather, B cell depletion during EAE disease progression dramatically suppressed symptoms.
efficacy.judgement: A separate track from the draft's rMOG model: different antigen (peptide), different lab, and a two-sided prediction keyed to timing.
efficacy.model: Mouse MOG35-55 peptide EAE (C57BL/6) with mouse anti-CD20, depletion before induction vs after onset

efficacy.magnitude_basis: EAE clinical score after onset vs human gadolinium-enhancing lesion count
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level for both papers; paired by us.
efficacy.quote: at week 24, the number of gadolinium-enhancing lesions was 89% (95% CI 68-97; p<0·0001) lower in the 600 mg ocrelizumab group than in the placebo group
efficacy.note: Depletion after onset suppressed mouse EAE, as ocrelizumab did lesions in established MS; the pre-induction worsening has no human counterpart. Retrodiction ruling: the model result (Matsushita 2008) was first public after rituximab's phase 2 HERMES trial (NEJM, Feb 2008) showed anti-CD20 depletion cut MS lesions.
efficacy.judgement: Scored on the therapeutic (after-onset) arm, the one that corresponds to treating established MS; the exacerbation from pre-induction depletion was untestable in patients, so partial.
efficacy.model: Mouse MOG35-55 peptide EAE (C57BL/6) with mouse anti-CD20, depletion before induction vs after onset

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 36792367). First presented at AAN 2019 per Roche 2020-09-09 release, which says this analysis drove MUSETTE/GAVOTTE; year opened at that proxy.
efficacy.note: Post hoc exposure quartiles: higher ocrelizumab exposure, lower disability progression, no safety cost; a higher dose not yet tested.
efficacy.quote: A consistent trend of higher ocrelizumab exposure leading to greater reduction in risk of disability progression was observed, particularly in the relapsing MS trials, and was not associated with a higher rate of adverse events.
efficacy.judgement: An in-silico model built on the pivotal patients; it is not a retrodiction for the high-dose question, which it predicted before MUSETTE/GAVOTTE ran.
efficacy.model: Population exposure-response analysis of ocrelizumab in OPERA I/II and ORATORIO (exposure quartile vs disability progression)

efficacy.magnitude_basis: predicted lower cCDP with higher exposure; observed 12-week cCDP HR 0.93 (MUSETTE) and 0.95 (GAVOTTE), high vs 600 mg
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Lancet, PMID 42208560). Year is the earliest public date, Roche's MUSETTE top-line release of 2025-04-02 (tier 5); the Lancet paper and NCT04544436 results (2026-02-17) confirm it.
efficacy.note: High-dose ocrelizumab (1200/1800 mg) did not slow disability progression beyond 600 mg in MUSETTE (HR 0.93) or GAVOTTE (HR 0.95).
efficacy.short: Higher dose gave no added benefit
efficacy.quote: In both studies, high-dose ocrelizumab did not further improve control of disability progression in either RMS or PPMS, and no new safety concerns were identified.
efficacy.reason: High dose failed its primary endpoint

patient_trials.quote: In MUSETTE, the percentage of patients with 12-week cCDP was 34% (198 of 577) with high-dose ocrelizumab versus 37% (104 of 283) with 600 mg ocrelizumab
In GAVOTTE, the percentage of patients with 12-week cCDP was 47% (235 of 500) with high-dose ocrelizumab versus 49% (124 of 253) with 600 mg ocrelizumab

efficacy.judgement: Stated comparison: the Lancet paper cites the post hoc exposure analysis as the rationale and tests it prospectively. Scored in efficacy, not dose: the higher exposure was given and the endpoint did not move.
efficacy.model: Population exposure-response analysis of ocrelizumab in OPERA I/II and ORATORIO (exposure quartile vs disability progression)

efficacy.magnitude_basis: lesion cell counts vs relapse rate
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC). Its hint that ofatumumab beats ocrelizumab has no head-to-head trial.
efficacy.model: Humanized-CD20 mouse with brain DTH lesions and tertiary lymphoid structures
efficacy.note: Intravenous ocrelizumab cut glial activation and lesion B and T cells in huCD20 mice after OPERA was known; retrodiction, ocrelizumab track.
efficacy.short: Ocrelizumab IV reproduced in huCD20 mice
efficacy.quote: Both treatments significantly decreased the extent of glial activation, as well as the number of B- and T-cells in the lesion following SC and IV administration, although this was mostly achieved to a greater extent with ofatumumab versus ocrelizumab.
efficacy.judgement: Track split from efficacy 3: the ocrelizumab IV arm against OPERA I/II (Hauser 2017). Retro: built after the result was known.

safety.confidence_note: OCR text; the stray '|' is in the OCR.
safety.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
safety.note: Monkeys given ofatumumab showed lymphoid atrophy and increased risk of infection secondary to B-cell depletion.
safety.quote: In monkeys, the primary effect of ofatumumab treatment was depletion of B-cells; other effects | were secondary to this primary effect and included histological changes (atrophy of the spleen, lymph nodes, and Peyer’s patches) and increased risk of infection.
safety.judgement: Opened on the CLL review; no MS patient data in 2009.

safety.confidence_note: Serious infections were not higher (1.3% vs 2.9%, Hauser 2017); the match is on any infection.
safety.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
safety.note: Ocrelizumab monkeys needed penicillin for nasal infections and some dams died of infection; MS patients had more infections than on interferon. Retrodiction ruling: the ocrelizumab monkey toxicology was first public in the 2017 review, after ocrelizumab's own infection data in patients (phase 2 2011; OPERA online Dec 2016).
safety.quote: In RMS trials, 58% of OCREVUS-treated patients experienced one or more infections compared to 52% of REBIF-treated patients.
safety.judgement: Paired: review and label are separate documents. Hepatitis B reactivation, PML and the breast-cancer imbalance are harms a 6-month monkey study could not show, so silence there is not scored.

safety.confidence_note: Monkey cytokines were sampled after repeated dosing, while human reactions peak at the first infusion; human cytokines were not reported.
safety.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
safety.note: Ublituximab raised no IL-6, IL-8, IFN-γ or TNF-α in monkeys; 48% of MS patients had infusion reactions, mostly after the first infusion. Retrodiction ruling: the monkey data were first public in the ublituximab review, after ublituximab's own infusion reactions in patients (phase 2 and ULTIMATE, 2021-22), and failed to reproduce them, so contra. Ublituximab track only; it does not carry to ocrelizumab.
safety.quote: The incidence of infusion reactions in Studies 1 and 2 in patients who received treatment with BRIUMVI was 48%, with the highest incidence within 24 hours of the first infusion.
safety.reason: Monkey cytokine silence missed infusion reactions
safety.judgement: Treated the monkey's measured absence of cytokine release as a prediction a primate could have shown (unlike a mouse); infusion reactions are a class effect, so the miss is soft.

safety.magnitude_basis: monkey first-dose IL-6 rise (15/16, fewer after dose 2) vs 34-40% infusion reactions, highest at first infusion
safety.confidence_note: Model side: 761053 PharmR study 02-082-0352 ('IL-6 levels were increased on SD1 at 2 hours post-dose in 15 of 16 animals'). The label quote elides a bracketed premedication clause.
safety.model: Cynomolgus monkey B-cell depletion PK/PD and toxicology
safety.note: Monkeys given ocrelizumab raised IL-6 two hours after the first dose (15 of 16), less after the second; MS patients' infusion reactions peaked at the first infusion. Retrodiction: review public after OPERA.
safety.quote: In multiple sclerosis (MS) clinical trials, the incidence of infusion reactions in OCREVUS-treated patients [...] was 34 to 40%, with the highest incidence with the first infusion.
safety.judgement: From the checker's missing list: the same track's first-dose IL-6 signal pairs with first-infusion reactions; strengthens the 2017 retro on the ocrelizumab track.
safety.reason: First-dose cytokine signal reproduced in patients
